title: The entity-curation judge's answer
description: One ROLE per numbered candidate item of ONE frame (modules/kg/curation.py): subject, source, format and platform are kept; incidental and wrong_sense are dropped. The judge may only classify the items it was shown — it can add nothing. Handed to Ollama as the format= grammar (with `n` narrowed to that call's numbers) and checked again with jsonschema. Editing this file re-asks every frame.
